senses.gloss:
mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
1 Best, most excellent, pre-eminent.
2 Very old, oldest.
3 Elder, elder born.
f. (-ष्ठा)
1 One of the asterisms considered as lunar mansions; the eighteenth, comprising three stars, of which one is a Scorpionis, figured by a ring or earring.
2 The middle finger.
3 Misfortune, personified as a goddess.
4 The Ganges.
(-ष्ठा or ष्ठी)
A small house lizard.
m. (-ष्ठः)
The month Jyaiṣṭha or Jeyte, (May-June.)
n. (-ष्ठं)
Age, oldness.
E.
ज्या to decay, to grow infirm or old, affix इष्ठन्, fem. affixes. टाप् and ङीष्.

f. (-ता)
1 Seniority.
2 Superiority.
E.
ज्येष्ठ, and तल् affix; also ज्येष्ठत्वं.

m. (-तः)
A father's elder brother.
E.
ज्येष्ठ elder born, and तात a father; the usual order of composition is here irregularly inverted.

f. (-र्य्या)
1 An elder brother's wife.
2 The elder or chief wife.
E.
ज्येष्ठ, and भार्य्या a wife.

m. (-र्णः)
A Brahman.
E.
ज्येष्ठ elder born or best, and वर्ण tribe.

f. (-त्तिः)
The duties of age or seniority.
E.
ज्येष्ठ, and वृत्ति practice.

mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं)
To be obtained by virtue or seniority, &c.
E.
ज्येष्ठ, and आवाप्य obtainable.

f. (-श्रूः)
A wife's elder sister.
E.
ज्येष्ठ elder, श्वश्रू motherin-law.

n. (-म)
1 A portion of the Sāma Veda.
2 A religious rite of which its perusal is a part.

m. (-शः)
1 The elder brother's share.
2 The best share.
E.
ज्येष्ठ, and अंश a share.

m. (-यः)
The month Jyeṣṭha.
E.
ज्येष्ठा the constellation, (as above,) मूल root, origin, and छ aff.

m. (-म्बुः)
The scum of boiled rice, or water in which grain has been washed.
E.
ज्येष्ठ, and अम्बु water.

m. (-मः)
1 The order of the householder.
2 A householder.
E.
ज्येष्ठ, and आश्रम order.

m. (-मी)
A householder, a man of the second order.
E.
ज्येष्ठ best, आश्रम order, इनि aff.
